page.layout: One printed page. Top: decorative fleuron border. Then full-width title block in capitals and italics (dedication heading). Below, main text in two-line-indented paragraph with large woodcut initial N at left. Faint show-through of the reverse page visible in the background and at the right margin and bottom; not transcribed. No running head, no page number, no marginal notes.

main_text.l: mam habuimus causam, quare ita nobis faciundum ex-
istimaremus. Quum enim plurima maximaq; in nos
beneficia contuleris, & quidem alterum quoq; nostrûm
ante aliquot annos honorificis conditionibus in Hiber-
niam evocatum (longè aliud iter tunc, atq; in Patriam
reditum meditantem) prolixè admodum habueris, atq;
propensissimo animo, omnibusq; veræ ac summæ bene-
volentiæ indiciis exinde jugiter prosecutus sis: commit-
tere non potuimus, quin hoc saltem gratitudinis nostræ
monimentum extare vellemus, atq; publicè, quantum
tibi deberemus, testatum facere. Neq; verò alienum
à te videri potest hoc opus, qui tantus es in Philosophia

page.notes: The initial N is a large woodcut initial, joined to the first word as "Neque". Faint show-through from the reverse page (partly legible Latin lines at the right and bottom, e.g. "...Iulij... Anno Christi 1613") was deliberately not transcribed. The word "quoque" at the end is set on the right, below the last line, and is printed there as the final word; it is kept as the last word of the paragraph.
